title: Quark: Kuro Shiba & Friends
description: Replaces Quark's grey shiba texture with a black shiba texture, and tweaks all shiba textures to look a lil' cuter.
body:
## Overview
Finally, we can all have kuro shibas in Minecraft. Replaces Quark's grey shiba with a kuro (black) shiba, and makes some small graphical tweaks to the other non-rare shibas.

## Details
- Grey shibas are now all black shibas.
- Other than the white shiba, all shibas:
  - Have the characteristic shiba eyebrow markings
  - Have differently coloured ear fluff

They really are sooo cute!

## Installation
Ensure that you've installed [Quark](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) (where the shibas actually come from) and have the shibas enabled (this is default in the mod).

Save the downloaded resource pack .zip file to the `resourcepacks` folder of your client, and enable within the game. [Learn more](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Loading_a_resource_pack)

## Compatibility
Currently tested for all Quark versions that feature the shibas. Feel free to get in touch via the Github [issues page](https://github.com/villainous-j/quark-kuro-shiba-resourcepack/issues) if you have any requests!
